title: Watch keys
wikitext: '''Watch keys''' or xpubs are useful to display your balance in case of Bisq wallet corruption '''without exposing private keys''' to an external wallet estimated by the Bisq [[wallet]]. Go to Account - Wallet Info to find your watch keys. ''Xpub'' is used to watch segwit (P2WPKH) addresses, and ''P2PKH'' or ''zpub'' is for legacy and BSQ addresses. [[File:Wallet - watchkeys.png|500px|thumb|left]] {{Admonition_Note|'''Don't import private keys to an external wallet.''' Use the [[emergency wallet]] instead.}} == Importing watch key to external wallet. == Import the watch keys one by one to [http://electrum.org/ Electrum] or [https://samouraiwallet.com/sentinel Sentinel] to display your balance safely. At Electrum, create a new Standard wallet through Use Master Key and paste the xpub or zpub, which is a string similar to ''xpub6CUGRUonZSQ4TWtTMmzXdrXDtypWKiKrhko4egpiMZbpiaQL2jkwSB1icqYh2cfDfVxdx4df189oLKnC5fSwqPfgyP3hooxujYzAu3fDVmz''. Similar steps are required for Sentinel. (Fixture edit for the converter test.) [[Category:Guides]] == Further reading == To spend the funds, see [[emergency wallet]].
